name: project-continuity
description: Maintain a lightweight, agent-driven project continuity protocol.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight continuity controls for agent projects.
interface.longDescription: Keeps current user intent, complete valid project knowledge, scoped rules, authority routes, current state, and one optional unfinished task contract recoverable while leaving project reasoning and execution to the agent.
defaultPrompt: Adopt this project and establish its current knowledge, constraints, and authority routes.
Resolve ambiguous scope or conflicting project authorities without retaining stale versions.
Pause or restore a checkpointed task without mixing worktree state.
